name: Charles Mitchell (colonial administrator)
contribution: A British Royal Marines officer and colonial administrator.

checks.lead: Sir Charles Bullen Hugh Mitchell  (1836 – 7 December 1899) was a British Royal Marines officer and colonial administrator. As the latter, he served in British Honduras, British Guiana, Natal. He then served as Governor of Fiji, of the British Colony of Natal & Zululand, and of the Straits Settlements.
